journey.name: Open a camera and come back
journey.description: From the camera list into one camera's own screen and back again with the system back gesture.

actions.action: Clear the server URL field and type http://10.0.2.2:8971, type admin as the username and correct-horse as the password, then tap "Connect"
Verify that the home screen lists the "Front Door" camera
Verify that the camera screen for "Front Door" is shown, with a back arrow at the top left and a "More options" menu at the top right
Verify that the list of cameras is shown again, including "Driveway" and "Back Yard"
